caseNameFull: J. D. Boxley v. E. M. Scott
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Oklahoma.
attorneys: Mr. Harry H. Rogers for plaintiff in error. Mr. William P. Langston for defendants in. error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
